periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique angle of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented from the medial-superior to the lateral-inferior direction.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Approximately 1.5:1, characterized by an elongated oval or teardrop-shaped blob rather than a circular geometry.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the inferior point extending significantly further from the geometric center than the superior point.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shape profile across the posterior edge of the transverse dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 40% of the visible torso length from the shoulder down to the transition to white pelage.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is approximately 1.4 times the maximum horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness with a consistent semi-circular curvature at the superior boundary of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-red chromatic staining visible on the ventral fur and tail region compared to the creamy-white cranial fur.
